1.t: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks

2.t: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺

3.t: and those who recite the Reminder

5.t: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise
5.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa Wa-Rabbul mashaariq

6.t: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration

7.t: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil

8.t: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side
8.tr: Laa yassamma-'oona ilal mala-'il a'alaa Wa-yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib

9.t: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment

10.t: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare
10.tr: Illaa man khatifal khatfata fa-atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib

11.t: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay
11.tr: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib

12.t: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺

13.t: When they are reminded, they are never mindful

14.t: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it

15.t: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic
15.tr: Wa-qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen

16.t: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
16.tr: A-izaa mitnaa Wa-kunnaa turaabanw Wa-'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab'oosoon

18.t: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”

19.t: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺
19.tr: Fa-innamaa hiya zajra-tunw waahidatun fa-izaa hum yanzuroon

20.t: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

21.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”
21.tr: Haazaa Yawmul Faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon

22.t: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship
22.tr: Uhshurul lazeena zalamoo Wa-azwaajahum Wa-maa kaanoo ya'budoon

23.t: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell
23.tr: Min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil Jaheem

24.t: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

25.t: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

26.t: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive

27.t: They will turn on each other, throwing blame

28.t: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

29.t: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own

30.t: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people
30.tr: Wa-maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen

31.t: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺

32.t: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

33.t: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment

34.t: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked

35.t: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly
35.tr: Innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon

36.t: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
36.tr: Wa-yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon

37.t: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers

38.t: You will certainly taste the painful torment

39.t: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do
39.tr: Wa-maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

40.t: But not the chosen servants of Allah

41.t: They will have a known provision

42.t: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured

45.t: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream

47.t: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it
47.tr: Laa feehaa ghawlunw Wa-laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon

48.t: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes

49.t: as if they were pristine pearls

50.t: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively

51.t: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺
51.tr: Qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen

52.t: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺

53.t: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”
53.tr: A-izaa mitnaa Wa-kunnaa turaabanw Wa-'izaaman 'a-innaa lamadeenoon

54.t: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”

55.t: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire

56.t: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me

57.t: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”
57.tr: Wa-law-laa ni'matu Rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen

58.t: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die

59.t: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”
59.tr: Illa mawtatanal oola Wa-maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen

60.t: This is truly the ultimate triumph

62.t: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm
62.tr: Azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz Zaqqoom

63.t: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers

64.t: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell
64.tr: Innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil Jaheem

66.t: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it
66.tr: Fa-innahum la-aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon

67.t: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink
67.tr: Summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem

68.t: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell

69.t: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray

70.t: so they rushed in their footsteps

71.t: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them

72.t: although We had certainly sent warners among them

73.t: See then what was the end of those who had been warned

74.t: But not the chosen servants of Allah

75.t: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding

76.t: We delivered him and his family from the great distress

77.t: and made his descendants the sole survivors

78.t: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

79.t: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”

80.t: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

81.t: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants

83.t: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham

84.t: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart

85.t: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping
85.tr: Iz qaala li-abeehi Wa-qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon

86.t: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah

87.t: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”

88.t: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺

90.t: So they turned their backs on him and went away

91.t: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺
91.tr: Faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon

92.t: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”

93.t: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand

94.t: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺

95.t: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺

96.t: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”

97.t: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
97.tr: Qaalub noo lahoo bun-yaanan fa-alqoohu fil jaheem

98.t: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior

99.t: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me
99.tr: Wa-qaala innee zaahibun ilaa Rabbee sa-yahdeen

100.t: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

101.t: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son

102.t: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”
102.tr: Falamma balagha ma'a-hus sa'ya qaala yaa-buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa-abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa' allaahu minas saabireen

103.t: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺

104.t: We called out to him, “O Abraham

105.t: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
105.tr: Qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

106.t: That was truly a revealing test

107.t: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice

108.t: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

110.t: This is how We reward the good-doers

111.t: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

112.t: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous

113.t: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves
113.tr: Wa-baaraknaa 'alaihi Wa-'alaaa Ishaaq; Wa-min zurriyya-tihimaa muhsinunw Wa-zaalimul linafsihee mubeen

114.t: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron

115.t: and delivered them and their people from the great distress

116.t: We helped them so it was they who prevailed

117.t: We gave them the clear Scripture

118.t: and guided them to the Straight Path

119.t: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

121.t: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

122.t: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants

123.t: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers

124.t: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

125.t: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—

126.t: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

127.t: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

128.t: But not the chosen servants of Allah

129.t: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

131.t: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

132.t: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

133.t: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers

134.t: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family

135.t: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

137.t: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day

138.t: and night. Will you not then understand

139.t: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers

140.t: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship

141.t: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺

142.t: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy

144.t: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection
144.tr: Lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

145.t: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out

146.t: and caused a squash plant to grow over him

147.t: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people
147.tr: Wa-arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon

148.t: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while

149.t: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons

150.t: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes
150.tr: Am khalaqnal malaaa'i-kata inaasanw Wa-hum shaahidoon

151.t: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say

152.t: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars

153.t: Has He chosen daughters over sons

154.t: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

155.t: Will you not then be mindful

156.t: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof

157.t: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true

158.t: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
158.tr: Wa-ja'aloo bainahoo Wa-bainal jinnati nasabaa; Wa-laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

159.t: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim

160.t: But not the chosen servants of Allah

161.t: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship

162.t: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him

163.t: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell

164.t: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺
164.tr: Wa-maa minnaaa illaa lahoo maqaamun ma'loom

165.t: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺

166.t: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”

168.t: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples

169.t: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”

170.t: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know

171.t: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers

172.t: that they would surely be helped

173.t: and that Our forces will certainly prevail

174.t: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺

175.t: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see

176.t: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment

177.t: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned
177.tr: Fa-izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen

178.t: And turn away from them for a while

179.t: You will see, and they too will see

180.t: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim

182.t: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds
